tagline: 佳能便携相机，1995 年发布
description: 佳能于1995年推出的便携相机。配备28-70mm f/5.6-7.8 (8 elements in 7 groups). Zoom retracts fully into the body.。使用Autoload, motordrive and rewind. MRC also available.。45cm.。

specs.镜头: 28-70mm f/5.6-7.8 (8 elements in 7 groups). Zoom retracts fully into the body.
specs.胶片/画幅: Autoload, motordrive and rewind. MRC also available.
specs.英文简介: A March 1995 model from Canon's Sure Shot series, the Sure Shot Z70W (Euro: Prima Super 28) is a compact camera with fully automatic autofocus and a zoom lens.
